subject: Agriculture
title: GPS-Guided Farming
description: A quick, practical guide to GPS-Guided Farming.

hook.text: GPS-guided tractors drive straighter than any human—within 2 centimeters. That precision saves fuel, seed, and fertilizer.

buildup.text: Before GPS, tractor rows overlapped or left gaps. Overlap wasted inputs; gaps reduced yield.

discovery.text: GPS auto-steer systems reduce overlap from 10% to under 1%. Across millions of acres, savings are enormous.

twist.text: Farmers can work at night, in fog, or in dust—the GPS doesn't need to see. Productivity nearly doubled.

climax.text: RTK GPS corrections achieve centimeter accuracy, enabling the same row to be planted, sprayed, and harvested precisely.

punchline.text: A satellite in space decides where the seed goes. The farmer just watches.

quiz.question: How accurate are modern GPS-guided tractors?
